method: Read each of the six complete original bootstrap security-deep hunks and trace directly relevant owned source/export/style paths. Observations are not a completed security scan.

reviews.subject: fix(material/datepicker): deprecate constructor injection in NativeDateAdapter (#26144)
reviews.source_observation: Constructor/declaration change applies to the exact NativeDateAdapter currently re-exported as LegacyNativeDateAdapter. The original16 constructor accepts matDateLocale:string and optional Platform; installed main22.1.7 types declare constructor(), with inject(MAT_DATE_LOCALE) inside runtime. Previous not-owned/irrelevant rationale ignored the public alias. Constructor/subclass compatibility requires repair or a substantiated allowed contract decision; no identity proof is claimed.

reviews.subject: fix(material/progress-bar): avoid CSP issues for apps not using buffer mode (#28946)
reviews.diff:
diff --git a/src/material/progress-bar/progress-bar.html b/src/material/progress-bar/progress-bar.html index c903f1930..f9d596ab7 100644 --- a/src/material/progress-bar/progress-bar.html +++ b/src/material/progress-bar/progress-bar.html @@ -6,7 +6,10 @@
-
+ + @if (mode === 'buffer') { +
+ }
reviews.source_observation: The hunk removes modern MDC buffer dots outside buffer mode to avoid CSP problems. Owned legacy markup instead has inline SVG pattern/rect, not modern buffer-dots, but the exported historical ordinary companion progress-bar Sass remains reachable and emits data:image/svg+xml. Review the current companion/runtime combination and CSP behavior individually; modern-template path alone cannot clear the entire reachable style contract.

reviews.subject: perf(material/tooltip): Defer injection of injectables not needed until tooltip is shown. (#30440)
reviews.source_observation: The hunk changes current MatTooltip private injections to lazy Injector lookups. Owned MatLegacyTooltip and local _MatTooltipBase retain historical constructor DI, so the optimization is not inherited through current MatTooltip. No fork of current MatTooltip is needed; preserving the old constructor behavior still needs explicit constructor/provider/lifecycle proof and current public injected-service review. Do not claim security clearance from the bootstrap bucket.

reviews.subject: fix(material/progress-bar): avoid CSP issues due to buffer dots (#31818)
reviews.source_observation: The modern progress-bar Sass changes a data-SVG mask to a radial-gradient. The facade exports an independently owned historical ordinary progress-bar companion theme, whose reachable vendored linear-progress Sass still constructs data-SVG. The owned legacy inline-SVG control is a distinct path. Resolve the companion emitted-CSS/CSP contract separately without rewriting the legacy reference CSS or hiding its mismatch.

reviews.subject: refactor: move trusted types logic into CDK (#32387)
reviews.source_observation: The hunk relocates trusted-types logic from current Material icon to @angular/cdk/private, including a bypass createHTML policy. The add-on has no authored import of this helper and owns no icon component. Current-peer MatIconRegistry may transitively use it internally, which differs from an authored dependency. Need complete authored-use and reachable input/sink review before closing; never import @angular/cdk/private to follow this relocation.

reviews.subject: fix(cdk/layout): avoid CSS injection attacks in media matcher
reviews.source_observation: Actual security fix strips braces from media-query strings before style-sheet insertRule in CDK MediaMatcher. The add-on authored direct MediaMatcher call is a fixed (prefers-reduced-motion) query; tooltip also delegates through public BreakpointObserver. Installed main22.1.7 peer source contains the brace stripping. This is useful main-floor source evidence, but actual21.x-floor implementation and exercised delegation remain required; no generic ancestry or cross-line clearance.

limitations: All six final dispositions remain pending; no vulnerability scanner output or generic source-path rationale is treated as clearance.
Installed main22.1.7 source observation does not establish21.x peer behavior.
Historical constructor incompatibility and reachable data-SVG companion styles need regression/contract review and repairs.
